versions.changelog:
Initial release – diagnose TLS/SSL certificate issues for any user-provided domain.

- Checks certificate trust chain, hostname/SAN matching, and expiration on HTTPS/TLS endpoints.
- Automatically diagnoses DNS resolution and network connectivity issues if a check fails, identifying the root cause.
- Supports custom ports and batch checking of multiple domains via file input.
- Produces both human-readable summaries and structured JSON output.
- Fully read-only operation: never scans, never writes, no credentials required—only diagnoses explicit user-specified domains.
